summary: Laird Superfood filed an 8-K on September 8, 2026 disclosing the appointment of Mark Johnson, 58, as Chief Financial Officer effective October 1, 2026; he will serve as principal financial officer and principal accounting officer. His offer letter, dated August 31, 2026, provides a $375,000 base salary, a 50% target bonus prorated from his start date, equity-plan eligibility, and six months' salary plus up to six months' COBRA severance on termination without cause or resignation for good reason. No price, premium, or deal terms apply. The filing includes Item 8.01 other events; this is a scheduled, non-abrupt CFO succession rather than a forced departure, so the special-situations tag is limited.
